title: Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward
summary: An NAACP lawsuit accuses the SpaceX-owned AI company of violating the Clean Air Act.
reason: Civil litigation brought by a private nonprofit (NAACP) over Clean Air Act violations is not an official government policy action or regulatory enforcement under rule 4-1, nor a model release, research artifact, business event, or OSS tool release. No rule covers it.
